integrity: Theorem proved by an explicit Lp conjugacy to a first-order differential operator, compact coefficient comparison, and half-line solution analysis. Standalone numerical checks do not replace the analytical proof; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Covers the one-variable operator on complex Lp(0,1) only for 1<p<infinity and the Fredholm definition of essential spectrum. Ordinary spectrum and Hilbert p=2 representation are prior results. General first-order dichotomy theorems may imply the index after nontrivial conjugacy; publication priority beyond the inspected sources is not established.
title: Fredholm indices and compactly stable crescents of a real-variable Cesàro operator
